name: motion-beat-punch-in
title: Punch-in on the Beat
description: Mỗi phách mạnh khung phóng vụt lên một chút rồi lùi về rất nhanh, mạnh hơn sau đoạn drop.

moworks.author: moworks

options.dropAt: beat index where the drop starts (0: every beat as after a drop, as the small demo)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: On each downbeat scale jumps by +0.03 (+0.07 after the drop) and decays back with time constant 0.11 s: s = 1 + A e^(-t / 0.11). Demo: A 0.07 every 0.5 s (120 BPM). Params: amp (0.03 / 0.07) · decay (τ 0.11 s) · beats.
